title: Fix Create Question dialog transparency and make question text optional

requirements.text: Change the Create Question dialog background from dark/transparent overlay to a solid white background to improve text readability

quotes: Dark/transparent background on Create Question dialog

acceptanceCriteria: Dialog background is solid white with no transparency
All text labels and input fields are clearly visible against the white background
Dialog maintains proper contrast ratios for accessibility

requirements.text: Remove the asterisk (*) from the Question Text field label and make the field truly optional to support image-only questions

quotes: Question Text field shows asterisk (*) making it mandatory

acceptanceCriteria: Question Text field label does not display an asterisk
Form validation allows submission with empty Question Text when Question Image is provided
Users can successfully create questions with only images and no text

requirements.text: Ensure all four option input fields are fully visible and properly spaced within the Create Question dialog layout

quotes: Options input fields may not be fully visible in dialog

acceptanceCriteria: All four option input fields (Option A, B, C, D) are visible without scrolling
Option fields have adequate spacing between them
Dialog height accommodates all fields comfortably

constraints: Do not modify backend/main.mo or any backend logic
Preserve the existing QuestionEditorDialog component structure
Maintain compatibility with the current question data model
Do not change the Subject, Chapter, Difficulty, or Class Level fields
nonGoals: Adding new fields to the question form
Modifying the Question Gallery display logic
Implementing test creation or user management features
